entries.text: Removed the Python TPC-DI data generator and its direct load. TPC-DI source data now comes only from the DIGen path.
details: Removed classes: TPCDIDataGenerator, TPCDISourceDataGenerator and TPCDIDataLoader (benchbox.core.tpcdi.generator, source_generators and loader).

Removed TPCDIConfig.enable_parallel and TPCDIConfig.max_workers, the parallel argument of get_simple_config, and the TPCDIConfig helpers that reported worker settings (get_performance_profile and the max_workers and enable_parallel keys of to_dict, from_dict, get_streaming_config, get_etl_config and get_batch_config).

Removed the enable_parallel and max_workers parameters of TPCDIBenchmark, the matching benchmark option names (enable_parallel, enable-parallel, max_workers, max-workers), and TPCDIBenchmark.optimize_database with its benchbox.TPCDI wrapper.
